Fallen-leader sleeve: winners vs losers

Population: all 280 setups of the canonical sleeve (SLEEVE-2026-1015-FALLEN-C2), 2001-06..2026-04. Winner = call hit 3x (105); loser = call expired worth <10% of premium (71). AUC = chance that a random winner has a higher value than a random loser (0.5 = no separation; above 0.57 or below 0.43 in BOTH halves = consistent). Charts: the 12 best and 12 worst trades the account actually took. Lines: price (log), 50- and 200-day averages, SPY and the median of the stock's industry peers, both scaled to the stock's price at the signal; vertical lines = entry and exit; bottom = the call's value as a multiple of premium.
